title: WebhookEntry

id.description: A history entry's id, a firing's or a skip's: a UUID the environment mints; a firing's is its session's command id, so a retry after a crash makes nothing twice.

kind.description: Whether the entry is a firing or a skip.

trigger.description: What made an entry: schedule (a due time on time), catch-up (the latest of due times missed while the environment was down, fired once) or run-now (routines.runNow).

dueAt.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

startedAt.description: When the firing started; for a skip, when it was recorded.

endedAt.description: When the firing ended; for a skip, when it was recorded.

outcome.description: How a delivered entry ended: succeeded (a firing), or failed (a failed firing, or a failing skip: pre-check-failed or cannot-start).

anyOf.description: Why a firing failed: run_error (its run ended in error), timed_out (its maximum duration passed and its run was interrupted), restart (its run was cut by a restart, or let go with its session still there) or drained (a drain cut its run and nothing continued it).
Why a delivered skip failed: its pre-check failed, or its firing could not start.

reason.description: Why it failed: a firing's failure reason, or the failing skip's; null when it succeeded.

anyOf.description: A session's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints (never the provider's resume id), kept in lowercase.

sessionId.description: The firing's session; null for a skip.

description: The entry a webhook delivers: its id, kind, trigger, due time, start and end, outcome, reason and session.
